# Regnskaberne banker på døren - disse aktier bliver interessante de kommende uger

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben (EuroInvestor) episode previewing the Q3 earnings season. It opens with Tryg's record quarter, and the panel calls the outlook only moderately optimistic: AI and tech valuations look stretched and ordinary companies are not growing much, but shipping and medtech/pharma could bring positive surprises. Listener questions cover platinum miner Sibanye Stillwater, Drägerwerk, DS Norden, Genmab, Carl Zeiss Meditec, Boliden and GomSpace, and most of the views are long-term holds or buys.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SBSW — Sibanye Stillwater | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Svendsen strongly bullish on platinum, owns shares bought at 12 and 8; stock ~10 after falling from 22.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen argues platinum is undervalued vs gold (historic 80% of gold price implies ~3300 vs ~1630) with structural deficit; expects platinum price to double. He flags high risk: South Africa jurisdiction and commodity price dependence.

#### Sell Triggers

- platinum price fails to rerate
- Russian platinum returns to market
- South African operational/political problems

> *"Den er jeg voldsomt optimistisk på. Men det der balladen, det er jo high risk."*

---

### 🟢 DRW3 — Drägerwerk | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Svendsen holds 5y, target 400; Persson notes breakout above resistance and uptrend.

#### Reasoning

Family-run safety/respiratory equipment maker restructured after Covid, raised prices and repaid hybrid capital; Svendsen sees deep undervaluation vs US peers and target 400 vs ~112. Technician Persson sees resistance broken at 80/100, suggests stop loss for profit protection.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below former resistance ~100
- margin improvement stalls

> *"udsigterne er faktisk ret fornuftige og gode for den der virksomhed"*

---

### 🟡 DNORD — DS Norden | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

After upgrade, Svendsen advises holding; tanker fleet locked ~2 years, NAV ~460-500.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen holds as a top-3 position; product tanker fleet chartered out ~2.5 years locks in earnings, NAV estimated ~500 DKK, dry bulk tailwind returning. Limited spot upside due to hedging strategy.

#### Sell Triggers

- tanker rates collapse after charter expiry
- dry bulk market weakens

> *"hold lige bare ud og tag den ro og glæd dig til, at verden måtte blive bedre"*

---

### 🟡 GMAB — Genmab | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Persson would not sell at break-even; sees 3000 possible; RSI ~80 implies near-term pause.

#### Reasoning

Host Persson (owns privately, admits bias) cites good pipeline data driving rally from ~1500 to 2400, expects possible move to prior high ~3000. Overbought RSI/momentum suggests consolidation until new data.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative trial data
- technical breakdown after overbought RSI

> *"jeg vil ikke umiddelbart sælge, men jeg har den jo også derhjemme til en helt anden pris"*

---

### 🟢 AFX — Carl Zeiss Meditec | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Svendsen owns, sees recovery from ~32 EUR to 100+ over 3-4 years as China issues fixed.

#### Reasoning

Quality microsurgery/ophthalmic equipment maker hit by China profitability problems; margins near zero vs historic 20%+; management tightening up. Svendsen expects slow 3-4 year recovery, not in crisis.

#### Sell Triggers

- China weakness persists
- margin restoration fails

> *"Det er jo sjældent, at en aktie, der har kostet 180, kan fås til 32"*

---

### 🟡 BOL — Boliden | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Persson would not sell; flat YTD vs Lundin +20%, could catch up over winter if operations stabilise.

#### Reasoning

Copper price up but Boliden flat due to mine shaft collapses; Persson expects catch-up with peers given ample reserves, provided no further accidents.

#### Sell Triggers

- further shaft collapses or fires
- commodity prices fall

> *"så jeg vil ikke sælge, og jeg kunne godt forestille mig, at måske hen over vinteren"*

---

### 🟡 GOMX — GomSpace | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen says story intact (defence satellite surveillance), considering buying more, but Q2 order intake fell.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen sees defence/Arctic surveillance demand supporting thesis, lean cost base; however large system orders lag and Q2 order intake declined, stock fell from ~25 to ~10.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued falling order intake
- failure to win large system/consortium orders

> *"jeg mener, at historien om Gomspace er intakt"*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Persson: electrification names (NKT, ABB, Wärtsilä, Schneider) have consolidated; possible re-entry.

#### Reasoning

Host notes AI/data centre buildout spreading to grid and transformers; recent pullbacks offer chance to join the wave ahead of earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex slowdown

> *"Vi kan både se, at NKT har sat sig lidt."*

---
